measurement.design: same archived WAT compiled by unchanged/experimental Cranelift, Rust in-process guest calls; two warmups, balanced ABBA/BAAB blocks; independent unsigned i64 oracle; zero-divisor traps; modulo 2^64 and rotl(17)
measurement.host_level: virtualized one-host descriptive, not controlled CPU-frequency microarchitecture throughput

independent_recheck.procedure: Downloaded archived ZIP bytes via GitHub, checked archive SHA-256 against GitHub job logs, parsed six raw CSV files, independently evaluated 100,000-call unsigned bitpattern checksums per case, recomputed each eight block ratio and median and checked each against exact audit JSON (absolute difference <1e-12), checked per-CSV hashes
independent_recheck.result: all six cases match; no independent rebuild of Wasmtime in local analysis environment
independent_recheck.raw_samples_preservation: Original CSV and qualified JSON archived under GitHub Actions artifact (30-day retention); source + audit procedures remain on isolated branch.

interpretation: Static x86 function-byte savings persist in forward cases, but the measured 4/12/20 live-value cases cluster near ratio 1.0 on this host. The experiment does NOT establish general runtime benefit or safe register-pressure profitability. Do not submit upstream on this evidence alone.
limitations: Not an automatically discovered new ZenoFCIS-synthesized instruction sequence; experimental hand-built fusion
Source-only bounded adjacent pair; no general pass/egraph or cross-target proof
Synthetic pure callee live ranges rather than real application workload
No sampling of CPU models, no stable frequency control, no per-instruction latency or uop counts
Whole AOT sizes remain unchanged in the producer's six contexts
Signed, 32-bit, reversed and nonadjacent cases excluded from fusion; verified only as negative controls
ISA flags undefined for DIV and not observed in this Wasm result; arbitrary machine state and poison not modeled
